rows.reasoning: Carter voted Y on final House passage of SB 1165 (2022) ("CARROLL Y CARTER Y CHAPLIK Y", "Passed 31-24-5-0-0"), a single-subject bill whose operative section provides that "Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex." Confining transgender girls to the boys' or coed teams matches the rung that would "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth." The same section "does not restrict the eligibility of any student to participate in any interscholastic or intramural athletic team or sport designated as being for "males", "men" or "boys" or designated as "coed" or "mixed"", which excludes the rung that would "completely ban all transgender athletes from competing in any organized sports competitions."
